methods: The report presents Activate analysis and forecasts; specific forecast methods are not described.
Consumer research draws on Activate’s 2017 Consumer Tech & Media Research Study, with chart-specific samples reported as n=4,047, n=2,406, and n=820.
Some eCommerce adoption measures are indexed from measured consumer preferences in the 2017 Consumer Tech & Media Research Study (n=4,047).
Top news sites were selected from comScore’s Top 100 digital news properties; counts include desktop and mobile sites.
For a YouTube creator analysis, each channel is treated as a unique creator.
The influencer list was Forbes’ Top 10 Influencers list, generated with Traackr and Captiv8 using reach, virality, engagement, earnings per post, outside endorsements, and reputation.
Analyses cite secondary sources including Alexa, comScore, and other topic-specific sources; no validation method is reported.
